summary.text: Rebecca Sharpe Lombard was the Libertarian Party nominee for Missouri's 8th District and lost the November 3, 2026 election to Jason Smith.
She describes herself as a Tower Grove South resident who works in IT, with degrees in math and public policy, and she ran for the Missouri House in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Sharpe Lombard describes herself as having grown up in rural Missouri and lived in the Tower Grove South neighborhood of St. Louis for about 20 years.
She reports degrees in math and public policy, work in IT, and experience in teaching, finance and contracts.
Sharpe Lombard was the Libertarian candidate for Missouri House District 80 in 2022, receiving 3.1% (329 votes) in a race won by incumbent Peter Merideth.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Libertarian primary unopposed.
Sharpe Lombard received 3.1% of the vote to Jason Smith's 67.7%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
